Overflow controls how content extending beyond a box is handled.
Box එJකේ size එකට වඩා content වුඩි වුJණාතේ overflow ඇති Jවනවා. visible Jපෙන්වනවා; hidden
clip කරනවා; auto අවශ්‍ය Jවලාවට scroll ලබාJදෙනවා; scroll scroll mechanism එකකේ ලබාJදෙනවා.
Keyboard access සහ වුදෙගතේ content hide වීම ගුන බලන්න.
A fixed-height notification panel with many messages.

Read the diagram: 1. Three boxes have the same height. 2. Visible content extends outside. 3.
Hidden clips it. 4. Auto makes overflowing content reachable by scrolling.
Visible box එJකන් lines පිටතට යනවා. Hidden ඒවා කපෙනවා. Auto එක scroll කිරීමට ඉඩ ලබාJදෙනවා.

.panel { height: 80px; overflow: auto; }
/* Try visible, hidden and scroll too. */
Expected result: The panel can be scrolled if its content exceeds 80px.
Interview question: What is the difference between overflow:hidden and auto?

Answer: Hidden clips overflow without a user scrolling interface; auto allows scrolling when
needed.
Practice: Make a 100px panel with 10 lines of text.
